set.body:
Outcome

Remove the duplicated Parcellation representation and use locus4s PartialSurjection as the sole assignment proof.

Work

- Migrate constructors and validation to the upstream direct constructors.
- Replace support, fiber, relation conversion, coarsening, and equivalence operations with authoritative locus4s operations.
- Change all-fiber consumers, especially MVPA feature-set planning, to materialize the upstream one-pass Relation[P,V] once rather than scanning ambient voxels per parcel.
- Preserve parcel-domain order, support semantics, background behavior, and owner/alignment failures.
- Add narrow ParcelAssignment role aliases only at scientific boundaries where they materially improve readability.
- Reserve Parcellation for a future rich atlas object containing metadata, hierarchy, and provenance; do not keep a wrapper with only assignment storage.

Acceptance

- No ScalaFIM primitive target-ordinal/sentinel assignment storage or duplicate validation remains.
- All existing parcellation behaviors are covered through PartialSurjection on JVM and Scala.js.
- The all-parcel MVPA path is structurally O(|V|+|P|), with an explicit performance regression court.
- Foreign/same-sized domain cases fail explicitly rather than being accepted by type-name coincidence.
- Atlas, surface, and MVPA consumers compile using the authoritative target/source domains.
set.title: Replace ScalaFIM Parcellation with locus4s PartialSurjection
